finalText: The only remaining `db.query` call is in the vendored `legacy-orm` adapter, which is explicitly marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so it's intentionally left alone. All 12 real source files (36 call sites across `packages/accounts`, `packages/billing`, `packages/orders`, `packages/support`, `packages/catalog`, `packages/analytics`) are migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.
